## 行程

### 上午: 中目黑 (Nakameguro)
* 交通: 品川搭山手線至惠比壽轉日比谷線至中目黑。 [路線](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Shinagawa+Prince+Hotel,+4+Chome-10-30+Takanawa,+Minato+City,+Tokyo+108-8611,+Japan/Nakameguro,+Meguro+City,+Tokyo+153-0061,+Japan/@35.6319509,139.7205341,14z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x60188a5760190fa7:0x762af933935909b0!2m2!1d139.7366216!2d35.627534!1m5!1m1!1s0x60188b382f36ab01:0xaa463fc3c5ac293a!2m2!1d139.7026251!2d35.6387161!3e3?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wKgBIAVAD&skid=a89b500c-c5e6-4598-a1f0-298163bd6a84) (40 min)
* 目黑川沿岸散步
* [星巴克臻選®東京烘焙工坊](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Starbucks+Reserve®+Roastery+Tokyo/@35.6492642,139.6925907,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b88b7d8f7ab:0x2133080e9923eaac!8m2!3d35.6492642!4d139.6925907!16s%2Fg%2F11fmh3q_7b?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=21436527-6019-4b09-a670-890b3ce76b22) (7am - 10pm)
* [代官山茑屋書店](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Tsutaya+Books+Daikanyama/@35.6490704,139.6886035,15.06z/data=!3m1!5s0x60188b4fc6ac5b49:0x4ceb5b05b48bad60!4m7!3m6!1s0x60188b4fbed0f881:0xd6f9dafad72a5ca9!8m2!3d35.6488866!4d139.6997888!15sChXku6PlrpjlsbHojJHlsYvmm7jlupdaGiIY5Luj5a6Y5bGxIOiMkSDlsYsg5pu45bqXkgEKYm9va19zdG9yZZoBI0NoWkRTVWhOTUc5blMwVkpRMEZuU1VOR2NHUnhVV1JCRUFF4AEA-gEECAAQHQ!16s%2Fg%2F1wbrxs80?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=44d9898f-68a2-4231-b8c8-06bed166c188) (9am - 10pm)

### 下午: 自由之丘 (Jiyugaoka)
* 交通: 從中目黑搭乘東急東橫線直達[自由之丘](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Jiyugaoka,+Meguro+City,+Tokyo+152-0035,+Japan/@35.6103054,139.6673705,16z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018f4e1c51d4547:0x395db73328f5ec1!8m2!3d35.6105884!4d139.6668931!16s%2Fm%2F03h2ckw?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=f306e41f-e6d7-4da3-a50e-85c1269e051f)
* 景點: 雜貨小店、[La Vita 廣場](https://www.google.com/maps/place/La+Vita+Jiyugaoka/@35.610669,139.6682118,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018f4e03337c899:0xa5244a5a12e0dbca!8m2!3d35.610669!4d139.6682118!16s%2Fg%2F11b6hyl1j8?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=d6999767-8424-421a-96ca-aa48c115c809) (8:30am - 8pm)、日式甜點屋。

* [DiverCity 購物中心](https://www.google.com/maps/place/DiverCity+Tokyo+Plaza/@35.6247851,139.7758551,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x601889f9d36ebaa5:0x67f4219bfa09db77!8m2!3d35.6247851!4d139.7758551!16s%2Fg%2F1hbpwy50x?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=448142a7-c970-42ef-a879-2ce0c5c89676) (11am - 8pm)
